privileged_info_for_vlm: The experiment must be saved as /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/posner_cueing.psyexp and the conditions as /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/posner_conditions.csv. The CSV must have exactly these columns: cue_direction, target_location, validity, correct_resp, soa. The target must appear at X-coordinates +0.5 or -0.5. The SOA values in the CSV must be 0.3 and 0.8. Static placeholders (e.g., squares or circles) must be visible at both potential target locations throughout the trial.
